schema.name: project_id
schema.label: Project Id
schema.description: The project this cover-page metric belongs to.

schema.name: metric_key
schema.label: Metric Key
schema.description: Stable machine identifier for this metric row within its project (e.g. 'total_cy', 'hours_op'). Matches the old app's metric_key values. Copied from jfb_metric_defaults.metric_key when a default is applied, or typed/slugified from the label for a project-specific metric. Not unique across the whole domain (only within one project) since every project can have its own 'total_cy' row.

schema.name: label
schema.label: Label
schema.description: Display label on the Metrics tab, e.g. "Total Volume Removed".

schema.name: source
schema.label: Source
schema.description: Which jfb_metric_sources.value this row uses -- 'manual' for a PE-typed value, or a data-view slug (e.g. 'dvw-jfb-metric-cy') for a live-computed one. No picklist binding -- pkl-jfb-metric-source is disabled (GET /picklists/:slug/values doesn't resolve domain_query sources yet; MetricsTab.jsx reads jfb_metric_sources directly instead, see METRICS_MIGRATION_PLAN.md).

schema.name: equipment_id
schema.label: Equipment Id
schema.description: Optional per-metric equipment scope for an Auto source (matches the old app's text-based equipment_filter, now a real FK). Null means the metric sums every equipment unit on the project.

schema.name: unit
schema.label: Unit
schema.description: Display unit (CY, SF, hrs, %). Auto-populated from jfb_metric_sources.unit when source is chosen; editable for a manual metric with no source-driven default.

schema.name: sort_order
schema.label: Sort Order
schema.description: Display order on the Metrics tab.

schema.name: active
schema.label: Active
schema.description: Whether this metric row is currently shown on the Metrics tab. False hides it without deleting any historical report_metric_value rows tied to it.
